name: Teamtailor
description:
Teamtailor brings your hiring work into the conversation. Ask about your open jobs, see how candidates move through each recruitment pipeline stage, and get quick summaries of a candidate's profile, application, and activity history.
You can also act on what you find: move applications between stages, add tags, set custom fields, manage todos, and leave the data ready for your next hiring decision. On the job side, update postings with screening questions, required skills and traits, and interview kits — everything a recruiter needs to keep candidates moving toward an offer.
Typical things to ask:

"Which jobs are actively hiring right now?"
"Show the hiring pipeline for the Backend Engineer role"
"Summarize the candidates in the interview stage"
"Who applied this week?"
"Move Anna to the next stage and tag her as top-candidate"

Works with your existing Teamtailor account and respects your user's permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Teamtailor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Teamtailor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.teamtailor.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Teamtailor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teamtailor lists 45 MCP tools, including add_job_interview_kit, add_job_question, add_job_skill_or_trait, add_tag, archive_question, complete_todo, create_question, create_todo, delete_todo, get_application, get_candidate, and get_job.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Teamtailor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Teamtailor in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Teamtailor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Teamtailor is developed by Teamtailor. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
